objective: Design and implement a Run State Manager to track run lifecycle, serialization, and reset behaviors.

steps.title: Design RunState data model
steps.description: Create serializable RunState POCO matching runtime needs (runId, seed, timestamps, player progress, deck state, acquired items, skill selection, metadata).

steps.title: Implement RunStateManager service
steps.description: Create RunStateManager with CreateNewRun, LoadRun, SaveRun, EndRun, ResetRun and events OnRunStarted/OnRunEnded/OnRunReset.

steps.title: Serialization & persistence
steps.description: Implement JSON serialization with versioning and migration hooks; save meta-progression separately under Application.persistentDataPath.

steps.title: Editor tooling (optional)
steps.description: Add EditorWindow to inspect and load saved RunState snapshots for debugging.

steps.title: Tests
steps.description: Unit and integration tests for run creation, deterministic seed behavior, save/load roundtrip, and reset semantics.

notes: Include a version tag in serialized RunState
Keep RunState compact; store heavy telemetry separately
Use Unity-friendly serialization; fallback to Newtonsoft if complex types are needed
